result: implemented; one cross-slice test update requested (internal/focusspec)
summary: Real Win32 windows route WM_MOUSEMOVE, WM_MOUSEWHEEL, WM_MOUSEHWHEEL and the eight WM_[LRMX]BUTTON(DOWN|UP) messages into element dispatch through hostWindow.onMouseInput / WindowOptions.OnMouseInput; App.OpenWindow dispatches them through window.dispatchInput inside a.Update and answers !Propagate. ClickState is refreshed at WM_SETTINGCHANGE and forgotten at WM_NCDESTROY; the hover-status report on tracking start is ported; the keyboard entry runs dispatch_event's head (modality, propagation, prevent-default reset). The pinned hover-gated on_mouse_move and button-filtered on_mouse_up are spelled; receive-everything callers moved to the ...All names. 07's scroll builders are forwarded by the Interactive mixin. TestFrameLoopRealWindowNotifyRepaints attributes every frame-source wake to its origin.
changes: gpui/win32input_windows.go (new): win32PressedButton (events.rs:378-388), win32MouseMoveEvent, win32WheelEvent (events.rs:574-604, 626-643), handleMouseMoveMsg (start_tracking_mouse, restore_cursor_after_hide, then the input callback; Some(1) without a callback), handleMouseWheelMsg (ScreenToClient, wheel lines / chars from the host's tracked MouseWheelSettings), handleMouseInputMsg (the dispatch-table arms)

gpui/win32host_windows.go: windowWndProc routes WM_MOUSEMOVE / WM_MOUSEWHEEL / WM_MOUSEHWHEEL / WM_[LRMX]BUTTON(DOWN|UP) through handleMouseInputMsg (no DefWindowProc, like the pin's Some(n)); hostWindow.onMouseInput wired from WindowOptions.OnMouseInput; WM_NCDESTROY forgetWin32ClickState(w)
gpui/desktop_windows.go: handleSettingChangeMsg calls w.clickState().systemUpdate(wparam) first (events.rs:1220); startMouseLeaveTracking reports hovered_status_change(true) (events.rs:1399-1405)

gpui/window.go: WindowOptions.OnMouseInput; OpenWindow installs the callback: optional user interceptor first, then window.dispatchInput inside a.Update, handled = !Propagate; nil / unregistered window not handled
gpui/key_dispatch.go: dispatchKeyEvent calls w.beginPlatformInputDispatch(event, app) first (window.rs:5746-5760)

gpui/div.go: OnMouseMove(f(*MouseMoveEvent,*Window,*App)) hover-gated bubble (div.rs:342-352); OnMouseUp(button, f(*MouseUpEvent,*Window,*App)) button-filtered hover-gated bubble (div.rs:223-236)
gpui/fluent.go: Interactive.OnMouseMove / OnMouseUp take the pinned shapes
gpui/interact_mixin.go: Interactive.OverflowScroll / OverflowXScroll / OverflowYScroll / RestrictScrollToAxis / TrackScroll forward to 07's DivElement builders
